implementation.reference_contract: The reference includes the same complete class declaration and contains only OSDefineMetaClassAndStructors(S540NvidiaGspPowerService, IOService) in the same namespace. It is compiled with the production kernel C++ flags.

loader_contract.loader_code: Executable __TEXT,__text; follow every local code relocation reachable from every loader entry.
loader_contract.comparison: Require identical reachable instruction bytes and relocation offsets, widths, kinds, PC-relative modes, target symbols and addends against the independently compiled SDK reference. The class string must be exactly S540NvidiaGspPowerService; only its gMetaClass and MetaClass vtable may be touched.
normalization: Canonicalize only Clang's translation-unit initializer basename.
Resolve rebased local text, class-string and data relocations to the same symbolic targets.

Resolve a relocation to a defined __cstring symbol by its actual symbol.value + encoded addend, with section-range and in-section NUL-terminator checks, and compare the exact bytes just as for a section-relative cstring relocation. This does not change the relocation kind, width, PC-relative mode, offset or instruction-byte comparison.
Remove at most 15 trailing bytes consisting solely of valid x86 alignment NOPs, never overlapping a relocated operand.
refused: An additional initializer/finalizer or extra reachable code operation.
An interior code pointer, unrelocated loader entry, unsupported relocation, unexpected external/addend or other class metadata.
Alternate legacy constructor/destructor tables and init-offset loader tables.
A project object with loader entries unless it is the exact reviewed Power object; the linked project bridge must independently match the same reviewed graph.
loader_contract.scope: The three imports below authorize only the verified metaclass loader graph, not all imports or arbitrary static initialization in an SDK reference or project object.

compiler_policy.reason: The kernel requires a real metaclass constructor and destructor. Clang's -fno-use-cxa-atexit alone does not disable LLVM18's later Mach-O global-dtor lowering pass. That pass otherwise replaces llvm.global_dtors with a second initializer registering __cxa_atexit. Disable that backend transformation; retain the real __mod_term_func entry consumed by XNU.
compiler_policy.failure_policy: Run the independent reference preflight before compiling the full original RM. Unknown compiler flags, missing finalizer, cxa registration or unmatched codegen fail the build. There is no fallback that omits destructors or accepts extra loader operations.
not_allowed: Accepting __cxa_atexit or __dso_handle because a compiler happens to emit them.
Blanket acceptance of C++ global constructors/finalizers.
